entities.name: Heart of Shanodin
entities.description: Enchanted glade in the Shanodin forest on Oneah that reveals one's true self.

entities.name: Amjad
entities.description: Tyrant who brings servants to the Heart to learn their nature.

entities.name: Ittono Khairt ni Hata Kan
entities.description: Amjad's Black Knight who reverts to a lover of music and falls for a dryad.

entities.name: Daisilodavi
entities.description: Amjad's Royal Assassin whose true self is an actor.

entities.name: Lord Glinham
entities.description: Fat merchant pursued by Amjad who became a holy man.

entities.name: Shanodin dryads
entities.description: Dryads inhabiting the forest and glade.

entities.name: Odamulus
entities.description: Seer quoted on the Heart's power.

events.summary: Amjad sends Ittono and Daisilodavi to the Heart in pursuit of Lord Glinham.
events.quote: King Amjad sent his Black Knight Ittono Khairt ni Hata Kan and his Royal Assassin Daisilodavi to the Heart of Shanodin

events.summary: Ittono reverts to his old self and falls in love with a dryad.
events.quote: fell in love with one of the glade's dryads

events.summary: Daisilodavi, acting his role, assassinates Glinham.
The assassin murders the dryad to reclaim Ittono for Amjad.
events.quote: The assassin then murdered the dryad as well

relations.quote: his Black Knight Ittono Khairt ni Hata Kan
